review: All 26 new 0.5.5 and 6 updated/new 0.5.6 images visually reviewed in RU/EN. Earlier image bytes retain their original provenance. Recovery Kit illustrations contain unusable synthetic example data. All 20 new Kubernetes images and 6 version-bearing images refreshed from 0.6.3 were visually reviewed in RU/EN; older image records retain their existing provenance.
knownLimitations: These are Flutter widget-test renderings with synthetic services, terminal output, local model states and 16 GiB AI hardware recommendation; no native shell, WSL distribution or model inference is started by captures.
Windows widget variants run on a macOS test host with system font aliases; these images do not establish native Windows or WSL compatibility.

Widget tests do not render a native OS keyboard. Keyboard screenshots reserve a 200 logical pixel inset, which a device keyboard would cover. Mobile RDP captures show Android widgets and synthetic remote frames; matching iOS layout tests run separately.
Each image records its actual source version and commit. New 0.5.5 captures come from the tagged source, not installed CI packages; source build 21016 differs from platform package build numbers.
Horizontal RDP menus and key strips scroll; a partially visible next action indicates more controls. Desktop pickers also scroll.

Recovery Kit 0.5.6 illustrations render the production paper widget with synthetic data, Android styling and a macOS font alias; native APK layout was checked separately on an Android API 36 ARM64 emulator. Visible source build 21017 is not a platform package build.

Kubernetes phone and desktop images are widget-test renders with synthetic cluster services; they do not demonstrate native cluster connectivity, OS chrome or platform fonts. The two phone GitOps images show a scrolled filter header; search is available by scrolling the header to the top.
